newsitem.title: USA: FHP in agreement with government.
newsitem.headline: FHP in agreement with government.

text.p: FHP International Corp said its FHP Inc unit reached an agreement with the federal government resolving the government's claims under an Office of Personnel Management (OPM) draft audit report.

The government asserted it was due in excess of $15 million due to FHP's pricing and rating practices under some contracts through the Federal Employees Health Benefits Program (FEHBP) in 1987 through 1991.

FHP said it has agreed to pay $12 million, which will be allocated by OPM to the FEHBP Contingency Reserve Funds for the regions covered by those contracts. The government released FHP from all claims covered by the draft audit report, FHP said.
